-- Generated by Maquettiste (sql-ddl/schema). Do not edit; changes are overwritten.
-- Schema of database main (PostgreSQL 16): tables 6, views 1, sequences 1.
-- Tables are in foreign-key dependency order: every table follows the tables it references.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS billing;

CREATE SEQUENCE billing.invoice_number_seq AS bigint START WITH 1000 INCREMENT BY 1;

-- billing.customers
CREATE TABLE billing.customers (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    name varchar(120) NOT NULL,
    email varchar(254) NOT NULL,
    customer_since date NULL,
    created_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz(6) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_customers PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_customers_email UNIQUE (email)
);

-- billing.invoices
CREATE TABLE billing.invoices (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    number varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    issued_on date NOT NULL,
    total_amount numeric(18,2) NULL,
    total_currency varchar(3) NULL,
    status varchar(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'D',
    notes text NULL,
    created_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz(6) NULL,
    deleted_at timestamptz(6) NULL,
    customer_id uuid NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_invoices PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_invoices_number UNIQUE (number),
    CONSTRAINT fk_invoices_customer_id FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES billing.customers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CONSTRAINT ck_invoice_status CHECK (status in (0, 1, 2, 3))
);
CREATE INDEX ix_invoices_issued_on ON billing.invoices (issued_on DESC);
COMMENT ON COLUMN billing.invoices.number IS 'Assigned on issue.';

-- billing.products
CREATE TABLE billing.products (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    sku varchar(40) NOT NULL,
    name varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    list_price_amount numeric(18,2) NULL,
    list_price_currency varchar(3) NULL,
    deleted_at timestamptz(6) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_products PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_products_sku UNIQUE (sku)
);

-- billing.invoice_lines
CREATE TABLE billing.invoice_lines (
    id char(26) NOT NULL,
    quantity integer NOT NULL,
    unit_price_amount numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
    unit_price_currency varchar(3) NOT NULL,
    description varchar(500) NULL,
    invoice_id uuid NOT NULL,
    product_id uuid NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_invoice_lines PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_invoice_lines_invoice_id FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id) REFERENCES billing.invoices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_invoice_lines_product_id FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES billing.products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

-- billing.payments
CREATE TABLE billing.payments (
    id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
    amount_amount numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
    amount_currency varchar(3) NOT NULL,
    received_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    reference varchar(64) NULL,
    created_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz(6) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_payments PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

-- billing.payment_invoice
CREATE TABLE billing.payment_invoice (
    payments_id bigint NOT NULL,
    invoices_id uuid NOT NULL,
    allocated_amount numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
    allocated_currency varchar(3) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_payment_invoice PRIMARY KEY (payments_id, invoices_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_payment_invoice_payments_id FOREIGN KEY (payments_id) REFERENCES billing.payments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_payment_invoice_invoices_id FOREIGN KEY (invoices_id) REFERENCES billing.invoices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE VIEW billing.outstanding_invoices AS
select id, number, issued_on from billing.invoices where status = 1;
